posts.cooked:
I was trying to figure out a way to describe why it is happening, but I will post part of her character card instead:

Increase damage dealt by Chokepoint by 1 to targets from any deck with a face-down card in the villain play area.

Reduce damage dealt to Chokepoint by 1 by targets from any deck with a face-down card in the villain play area.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Makes more sense.   Thanks for posting these.

Episode 5

Advanced Chokepoint versus The Adamant Sentinels, Captain Cosmic, and The Desperate Prey Naturalist in The Temple of Zhu Long.

 

Setup

The Sentinels start with Coordinated Assault, Dark Delusions, Fling Into Darkness, and Coordinated Assault.

Captain Cosmic starts with Wounding Buffer, Energy Bracer, Energy Bracer, and Cosmic Weapon.

The Naturalist starts with The Predator's Eye, Bestial Shift, Cornered Beast, and The Nimble Gazelle.

Round 1

Chokepoint plays Ireful Grasp, dealing 3 damage to Doctor Medico (11), Mainstay (12), The Idealist (9), Writhe (10), Captain Cosmic (24), and The Naturalist (24). Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Captain Cosmic (22). The Naturalist puts Cornered Beast face-down in Chokepoint's play area.

The Sentinels play Coordinated Assault, Mainstay deals 5 damage to Chokepoint (65). The Sentinels use T.K. Thump, The Idealist deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (64) and damage dealt by Chokepoint is reduced by 1. The Sentinels draw Second Chance.

Captain Cosmic plays Wounding Buffer on The Naturalist. He uses Fabrication to put Autonomous Blade onto The Idealist. Draws Dynamic Siphon.

The Naturalist plays The Nimble Gazelle. Uses Desperate Prey for Crocodile and draws Indomitable Force. Draws Natural-Born Vigor. 

The Temple of Zhu Long plays The True Form. The True Form deals 3 and 3 damage to The Naturalist (18). Wounding Buffer deals 2 damage to The True Form (11).

Round 2

Chokepoint plays Harvest the Mighty, Chokepoint deals 3 to Mainstay (9). Chokepoint deals 1 damage to Captain Cosmic (21). The Naturalist puts Indomitable Force face-down in Chokepoint's play area.

The Sentinels play Coordinated Assualt, Mainstay deals 5 damage to Chokepoint (59). Uses T.K. Thump, The Idealist deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (58) and damage dealt by Chokepoint is reduced by 1. Autonomous Blade deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (56). Draws Second Chance.

Captain Cosmic plays Dynamic Siphon on The Idealist. Uses Fabrication and plays Harsh Offense, revealing Wounding Buffer, Destructive Response, and Harsh Offense. Captain Cosmic deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (54). Draws Augmented Ally.

The Naturalist plays Predator's Eye, increasing damage dealt to Chokepoint by 1, and deals 4 damage to Chokepoint (50). Uses Desperate Prey for Rhino, plays Bestial Shift. 3 HP regained for The Naturalist (21), reduce damage dealt by 1 to the Naturalist until the start of his next turn, deals 4 damage to Chokepoint (46), and uses Nimble Gazelle to regain 3 HP to The Naturalist (24). Draws Blend Into the Pack.

The Temple of Zhu Long plays Resurrection Ritual. The True Form deals 2 and 2 damage to The Naturalist (20). Wounding Buffer deals 2 damage to The True Form (9).

Round 3

Chokepoint plays Shocking Animation face-down in her play area. Chokepoint deals 1 damage to Captain Cosmic (20). The Sentinels put Second Chance face-down in Chokepoint's play area.

The Sentinels play Dark Delusions; Writhe deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (43), Idealist deals 4 damage to Chokepoint (39), and Autonmous Blade deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (36). Uses T.K. Thump, The Idealist deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (34) and reduces the damage she deals by 1. Draws Horryfing Dichotomy.

Captain Cosmic plays Energy Bracer on The Naturalist. Uses Fabrication to put Conservation of Energy into hand. Draws Unflagging Animation.

The Naturalist plays Natural-Born Vigor. Uses Desperate Prey for Crocodile and draws Hyperactive Senses. Uses Nimble Gazelle to regain 3 HP for The Naturalist (23). Draws Indomitable Force.

The Temple of Zhu Long plays Apprentice Poisoner. The True Form deals 2 and 2 damage to The Naturalist (19). Wounding Buffer deals 2 damage to The True Form (7). Apprentice Poisoner deals 1 damage to Autonomous Blade (3) and Dynamic Siphon (8). The Idealist uses T.K. Thump to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (33), reduces the damage she deals by 1, and Autonomous Blade deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (31).

Round 4

Chokepoint flips. Plays Harvest the Mighty, Chokepoint deals 3 damage to Doctor Medico (8). Chokepoint destroys the face-down Second Chance and deals 2 damage to Captain Cosmic (18).

The Sentinels play Horryfing Dichotomy, Doctor Medico and Writhe each deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (25). The Idealist uses T.K. Thump to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (24). draws Caliginous Form.

Captain Cosmic plays Cosmic Weapon on Captain Cosmic. Uses Cosmic Weapon to deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (21). Draws Vitality Conduit.

The Naturalist plays Indomitable Force. Uses Nimble Gazelle to heal 3 HP for The Natualist (22). Uses Desperate Prey for Rhino and plays Blend into the Pack. Draws Natural Form's Power. 

The Temple of Zhu Long plays Mysterious Ceremonies. The True Form deals 3 and 3 damage to Chokepoint (15). Apprentice Poisoner deals 1 damage to Dynamic Siphon and Autonomous Blade, but is redirected to The Naturalist for no damage. Mysterious Ceremonies has Captain Cosmic play Energy Bracer on The Naturalist.

Round 5

Chokepoint plays Newfound Power, revealing Ireful Grasp. Second Chance, Conservation of Energy, and Hyperactive Senses go face-down in Chokepoint's play area. Ireful Grasp is put into play, Chokepoint tries to deal all Hero targets 3 damage, but is redirected to The Naturalist for no damage. Chokepoint destroys the face-down Second Chance and deals 1 damage to The Naturalist (21). Wounding Buffer deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (14).

The Sentinels play Caligonous Form. Uses T.K. Thump to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (13). Draws Horrifying Dichotomy.

Captain Cosmic plays Unflagging Animation. Uses Cosmic Weapon to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (11). Draws Construct Cataclysm.

Indomitable Force is destroyed. The Naturalist plays Natural Form's Power. Uses Deperate Prey for Crocodile and draws Environmental Allies. Uses Natural Form's Power to regain 2 HP for The Naturalist (23), draw Cornered Beast and Shifter's Strength, and deal 1 damage to The True Form (6) and Poisoner Apprentice (2). Draws Hyperactive Senses.

Mysterious Ceremonies reveal a Mysterious Ceremonies and puts it into play. The Temple of Zhu Long plays Master of the Temple. The True Form deals 3 and 3 damage to Captain Cosmic (12). Poisoner Apprentice deals 1 damage to Autonomous Blade (2) and Dynamic Siphon (2). The Idealist uses T.K. Thump to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (10) and Autonomouns Blade deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (7). Mysterious Ceremonies allows The Sentinels to play Horrifying Dichotomy, Doctor Medico and Writhe each deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (2). Mysterious Ceremonies allow Captain Cosmic to play Construct Cataclysm, destroying 6 Constructs, then deals 6 damage to Chokepoint (-4).

Heroes win: Doctor Medico at 8 HP, Mainstay at 9 HP, The Idealist at 9 HP, Writhe at 10 HP, Captain Cosmic at 12 HP, and The Naturalist at 23 HP.

Note: Chokepoint's flipside advance is:

The First time a hero card would be discarded each turn, put it face-down in the villain play area instead.

No hero discarded a card this game, so it never occured.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I'm going to guess the advanced text on the front side is to put a card from a hero deck in her play area face down.   The first few rounds made me think it was from the highest HP hero but when the Sentinels do it round three that can't be the case.

Episode 6

Chokepoint versus K.N.Y.F.E., Sky-Scraper, and Mister Fixer in Magmaria

 

Setup

K.N.Y.F.E. start s with Kinectic Neutralizer, Overcharged Null-Shield, Wrecking Uppercut, and Amplified Combatant.

Sky-Scraper starts with Linking Incursion, Undetectable Relinking, Explosive Reveal, and Compulsion Cannister.

Mister Fixer starts with Bloody Knuckles, Salvage Yard, Tool Box, and Bloody Knuckles.

Round 1

Chokepoint plays Harvest the Mighty, dealing 4 damage to Sky-Scraper (29). Chokepoint deals 2 damage to K.N.Y.F.E (28).

K.N.Y.F.E. plays Kinetic Neutralizer. Uses Energy Lance, dealing 3 damage to Chokepoint (67). Draws Battlefield Experience.

Sky-Scraper plays Compulsion Cannister on Chokepoint, Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (65). Sky-Scraper uses Surveillance, drawing Thorathian Monolith and Proportionist. Draws Rest and Recover.

Mister Fixer plays Tool Box, drawing Tool Box and Harmony. Uses Strike to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (64). Draws Grease Gun.

Magmarian plays Fiery Crystallization.

Round 2

Chokepoint plays Kinetic Looty, destroying Tool Box and putting it face-down in Chokepoint's play area. Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Sky-Scraper (27).

K.N.Y.F.E. plays Overcharged Null-Shield. Uses Energy Lance to deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (61). Draws Battlefield Experience.

Sky-Scraper plays Proportionist. Uses Survveillance, drawing Neutalizing Resonator and Cortext Stimulator. Draws COmpulsion Cannister.

Mister Fixer plays Harmony. Uses Strike to deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (60). Draws Tire Iron.

Magmaria plays Crystalloid Behemoth, dealing 4 damage to Chokepoint (56), K.N.Y.F.E. (24), Sky-Scraper (23), Mister Fixer (24), and Crystalloid Behemoth (7).

Round 3

Chokepoint plays Augmented Energy Field. Deals 1 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (23).

K.N.Y.F.E. plays and uses Battlefield Experience, dealing 2 and 2 to the Crystallod Behemoth (3), draws Flawless Execution, plays Wrecking Uppercut to deal 3 damage to the Crystalloid Behemoth (X), discarded Augmented Energy Field, and Crystalloid Behemoth goes into Mister Fixer's hand. Battle Field Experience moves face-down into Chokepoint's play area. Draws Primed Punch.

Sky-Scraper plays Cortex Hyperstimulator on Chokepoint. Uses Surveillance to draw Proportionist and Rest and Recover. Draws Undetectable Relinking.

Mister Fixer plays Tire Iron. Draws Meditation.

Magmaria plays Fiery Crystallization.

Round 4

Chokepoint plays Shocking Animation on Tire Iron. Chokepoint deals 1 damage to Mister Fixer (23).

K.N.Y.F.E. plays Primed Punch. Uses Energy Lance to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (59). Draws Focusing Conduit Blade.

Sky-Scrapper plays Linking Incursion, switching to Tiny, drawing Colassal Left Hook, putting Cortex Hyperstimulator and Neutrallizing Resonator on Chokepoint, and Chokepoint discards Ireful Grasp. Sky-Scraper uses Sneaking to play Compulsion Cannister and Neutralizing Resonator on Chokepoint, Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Chokepoint (57), Chokepoint discards Aumented Energy Field. Sky-Scraper draws Tectonic Chokeslam.

Mister Fixer plays Meditation, putting Driving Mantis into play. Uses Strike, dealing 1 damage to Chokepoint (56). Draws Tire Iron. Tire Iron deals 2 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (21), Sky-Scraper (21), Tire Iron (3), and Mister Fixer but Mister Fixer redirects it for 1 damage to Chokepoint (55).

Magmaria plays Magmarian Throng. Magmarian Throng reveals Magmarian Defender, putting it into play, and discards all other revealed cards.

Round 5

Chokepoint plays Harvest the Mighty, dealing 2 damage to Sky-Scraper (19) and moves a Cortex Hyperstimulator Face-down in Chokepoint's play area. Chokepoint deals 2 damage to Mister Fixer, which is redirected for 1 at Chokepoint (54).

K.N.Y.F.E. plays Focusing Conduit Blade, uses Energy Lance to deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (51). Draws For the Greater Good.

Sky-Scraper destroys Kinetic Looter and destroys Neutralizing Resonator. Sky-Scraper destroys Augmented Energy Field and destroys Neutralizing Resonator. Sky-Scraper plays Colossal Left Hook, switching to Huge and dealing 1 damage to Chokepoint (50) and Seismic Defender (9), dealing 3 damage to Chokepoint (47), and discarding Rest and Recover. Plays Undetectable relinking, switching to tiny and drawing Rebounding Debilitator, moving 3 Links back into hand, playing two Compulsion Cannisters, Chokepoint deals 2 and 2 damage to Chokepoint (43) and Seismic Defender (5), and a Cortex Hyperstimulator. she uses Sneaking to play Rebounding Debilitator, Chokepoint discards Material Upheaval, Chokepoint moves a Compulsion Cannister into hand. Draws Micro Assembler.

Mister Fixer plays Tool Box, drawing Jack handle and Grease Monkey Fist. Uses Strike, dealing 2 damage to Chokepoint (41). Draws Pipewrench. Tire Iron deals 2 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (19), Sky-Scraper (17), Tire Iron (1) and Mister Fixer, Mister Fixer redirects it to Chokepont (39).

Fiery Crystallization has Seismic Defender deal 1 damage to Chokepoint (38), K.N.Y.F.E. (18), Sky-Scraper (16), Mister Fixer and is redirecting it to Chokepoint (37), and Tire Iron (X). Tire Iron is moved Face-down in Chokepoint's play area and Shocking Animation is destroyed. Fiery Crystallization also destroys Tool Box. Fiery Crystallization deals 1 damage to Chokepoint (36), K.N.Y.F.E. (17), Sky-Scraper (15), and Mister Fixer (22). Magmaria plays Smoldering Crystal. Magmarian Throng reveals until getting Stone Shaper, discarding the rest of the revealed cards. Seismic Defender allows Mister Fixer to discard Crystalloid Behemoth, then Seismic Defender deals 3 and 3 damage to Chokepoint (30). 

Round 6

Chokepoint flips. Plays Shocking Animation on Rebound Debilitator. Chokepoint destroys the face-down Cortex Hyperstimulator and deals 4 damage to Mister Fixer, but Rebounding Debilitator prevents the damage and is moved Face-down in Chokepoint's play area.

K.N.Y.F.E. plays Amplified Combatant, dealing 2 and 1 damage to Chokepoint (27), Seismic Defender (2), and Stone Shaper (5). Uses Energy Lance to deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (24). Draws Overdo it.

Sky-Scraper plays Undetectable relinking, moving all Links in play to her hand. Sky-Scraper plays two Compulsion Cannisters, Chokepoint deals 2 and 2 damage to Chokepoint (20) and Stone Shaper (1). Uses Sneaky to play Cortex Hyperstimulator on Chokepoint and Micro Assembler on Mister Fixer, movess Cortex Hyperstimulator and a Neutralizing Resonator from the trash into hand. Draws Linking Incursion. 

Mister Fixer plays Jack Handle. uses Strike, dealing 1 damage to Chokepoint (19), and 2 damage to Seismic Defender (X) and Stone Shaper (X). Draws Overdrive.

Magmaria plays Innercore Tunneler. Magmarian Throng reveals until Crystal Collector is put into play. Crystal Collector allows Mister Fixer to discard Tire Iron and draw Riveting Crane, Overdriver, and Alternating Tiger Claw. 

Round 7

Chokepoint plays Material Upheaval, dealing 2 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (15), Inner Core Tunneler (10), Crystal Collector (4), and Mister Fixer but is redirected to Chokepoint (17). She deals 3 damage to Sky-Scraper (12). Chokepoint moves Focusing Conduit Blade, Cortex Hyperstimulator, and Jack Handle face-down in Chokepoint's play area. Chokepoint destroys the face-down Focusing Conduit Blade and deals 5 damage to Mister Fixer (17).

K.N.Y.F.E. deals 4 damage to Chokepoint (13) and Primed Punch is destroyed. K.N.Y.F.E. plays and uses Battlefield Experience, dealing 2 and 2 to Chokepoint (9), draws Prototype Servo Gauntlet. Plays For The Greater Good, dealing 3 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (13) and draws Energy Burn. Plays and uses Prototype Servo-Gauntlent to deal 3 damage to Chokepoint (6). Draws Incendental COntact.

Sky-Scraper plays Tectonic Chokeslam, switching to huge, dealing 1 damage to Inner Core Tunnler (9) and Crystal Collector (3), deals 3 damage to Chokepoint (3), 1 damage to Inner Core Tenneler (8) and Crystal Collector (2). Uses Concussive Clap to deal 2 damage to Chokepoint (1), 3 damage to Inner Core Tunneler (5) and Crystal Collector (X), 1 damage to K.N.Y.F.E. (12), Sky-Scraper (11), and Mister Fixer but is redirected to Inner Core Tunneler (4). Draws Undetectable Relinking.

Mister Fixer plays OVerdrive. uses Micro-Assembler to get Dual Crowbars from his deck and put it into play. Uses Strike to deal 3 damage to Inner Core Tunneler (1). Uses Strike to deal 3 damage to the Inner Core Tunneler (X) and 4 damage to Chokepoint (-3).

 

Heroes Win: K.N.Y.F.E. at 12 HP, Sky-Scraper at 11 HP, and Mister Fixer at 17 HP.

Powerhound_2000:

I'm going to guess the advanced text on the front side is to put a card from a hero deck in her play area face down.   The first few rounds made me think it was from the highest HP hero but when the Sentinels do it round three that can't be the case.  

Close, it's the player with the most cards in hand.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Ahh so the player with the most cards in hand has to put a card from their hand and put it face down in Chokepoint's play area.
